$comment: The only list of artifacts (spec §5.1). `row` is the strategy's Artifacts row as skills/qa-test-strategy/template.md names it; `derivedFrom` marks an artifact selected whenever that artifact or row is ("Scenarios" = at least one scenario in the strategy's `### Scenarios` table). `per: "scenario"` is a template the planner instantiates once per approved scenario as `scenario:S-n`; `proofs` gives its capabilities by the scenario's Proof, and for a browser proof the pool of lanes (tried in order, each needing its own `mcp:<name>`; no two browser entries in a wave share a lane — one browser session per agent). `needs` waits only for selected artifacts. `writes` is relative to the run folder <run> (or the knowledge store <store>) and never spells a literal reports/tickets/ path (write-zones.mjs checks it); `per: "prior-bug"` is instantiated the same way, once per `### Prior bugs` row of a round ≥ 2, as `bug:PB-n` (proof `spec` when its Reproduction names a .spec, else `browser`; its rows go to `PB-n.rows.md`); a scenario never writes testing-checklist.md — the orchestrator merges its S-n.rows.md there after each wave (scenario-rows.mjs).
